description: FAST AC/DC CHARGING, SOLAR AS A CONVENIENT BACKUP — Charge quickly and reliably via the included Micro AC/DC charger for everyday use. LONG-LASTING LITHIUM-ION BATTERY WITH OVERCHARGE PROTECTION — The built-in 1800mAh battery includes overcharging protection for safer, longer-term use, and also functions as a power bank for emergency mobile charging. VERSATILE FOR HOME, OUTDOOR & EMERGENCY USE — Genuinely useful for camping, hiking, outdoor cycling, fishing, and other outdoor activities, as well as everyday indoor use like reading or task lighting. Also works well as a warning or alert light during roadside emergencies. MAGNETIC CLAMPS FOR HANDS-FREE MOUNTING — The included pair of magnetic clamps let you attach the light securely to metal surfaces — garages, kitchens, vehicles, or work areas — for convenient, hands-free use anywhere.
